# ramoops_logger v0.4.0 - Table of Contents

> Elixir Logger for Linux Ramoops

## Pages

- [RamoopsLogger](https://ramoops-logger.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://ramoops-logger.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [RamoopsLogger](https://ramoops-logger.hexdocs.pm/RamoopsLogger.md): This module provides an in-memory log handler for the Erlang logger that can survive reboots.
- [RamoopsLogger.PmsgHandler](https://ramoops-logger.hexdocs.pm/RamoopsLogger.PmsgHandler.md): Minimal Erlang logger handler that writes log events to /dev/pmsg0.
